title: The Structure of Political Difference

## Definitions first

A *difference* is a fact about a distribution; a *disagreement* is a fact about a practice. The essay's central move is to keep them apart — most political analysis conflates them \[@rawls1971].

## The table of cases

| Case | Difference | Disagreement |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Tax code | income | policy |
| Speech | reach | legitimacy |
| Borders | jurisdiction | membership |

## Two worked examples

1. The committee's rule `vote(A, B) -> tally` treats a difference as a disagreement and so miscounts abstention.
2. The appellate reading treats a disagreement as a difference and so dissolves the standing question.

```text
for each case c in ledger:
    if c.differs(dist(c)) and not c.disputes(practice(c)):
        mark(c, "asymmetry")
```
